title: Y Combinator CEO open-sources G-Stack Cloud Code ops toolkit #garytan #gstack #cloudops
description:
Gary Tan open-sourced G-Stack, a 23-tool Cloud Code setup that functions like a full ops team. It automates product planning, design, engineering management, quality assurance, and release management, streamlining the entire cloud development lifecycle with one install.

G-Stack represents a major shift in cloud infrastructure management by combining AI-driven roles to reduce manual oversight and accelerate shipping. With over 108,000 stars, this free toolkit reflects the exact system used by the Y Combinator CEO for efficient startup acceleration.

The innovation lies in delegating specialized tasks—like architectural locking, real browser testing, and release automation—to AI tools, enabling teams to scale cloud operations without increasing overhead. This approach can transform workflows across startups and enterprises aiming to optimize cloud deployment and reliability.
